name: Deadly Venom 2: Origins
summary:
Deadly Venom 2 - Origins sets you back a few years when our female assassin began to confront the corrupted company Dynasty for the first time. Embark on your initial mission against this evil empire by hacking their mainframe and taking down their security system.

This prequel has even more stealth objectives, close combat moves and new weapons to find. There will be areas of hostility which will require some strategy. Use flash grenades to temporarily disorient your adversary and take them out one after the other. Or if you're lucky enough to find a lethal grenade, just take them out with one blow. Be careful and use your weapons wisely as you will encounter various versions of cloned guards, each with a different level of threat.
